children.name: talos/copro_agent
children.role: micro-ROS agent on the CAN bus (can0): turns the firmware boards' CAN traffic into ROS topics and services. Without it no board talks to ROS: no kill switch state, no depth, no thruster telemetry.

children.name: copro_agent
children.role: micro-ROS agent on the CAN bus (can0): turns the firmware boards' CAN traffic into ROS topics and services. Without it no board talks to ROS: no kill switch state, no depth, no thruster telemetry.

children.name: talos/dvl
children.role: Nortek DVL driver: connects to the DVL over Ethernet (host uwrt-dvl, port 9004) and publishes dvl_twist (velocity over the floor) and dvl/status.

children.name: talos/<node_name_unspecified>
children.role: VectorNav IMU driver (node riptide_imu): serial port from imu_port, publishes vectornav/imu plus magnetometer and pressure.

children.name: talos/riptide_gyro
children.role: Fibre-optic gyro (FOG) driver on gyro_port: publishes gyro/raw, gyro/status and gyro/twist (yaw rate for the EKF).

children.name: talos/apriltag/tag_container
apriltag_36h11
children.role: Detects 36h11 AprilTags (0.508 m) in the front camera's compressed images.
Container process for the AprilTag detector (the tag sits on the pool wall; mapping uses it to place the map).

children.name: talos/surface_frame_node
children.role: Static transform tag36h11:0 -> estimated_origin_frame (0.4572 m from the tag, rotated), the frame the Mapping panel's tag calibration uses.

children.name: talos/riptide_acoustics
children.role: Acoustics: pinger direction finding from the hydrophone board's data. Nereus does not simulate acoustics.

children.name: talos/simple_actuator_interface
children.role: Turns the one-shot topics command/simple_torpedo_fire and command/simple_dropper_fire into the arm and fire service calls.

children.name: talos/imu_power_cycle
children.role: Power-cycles the IMU through an Orin GPIO pin (pin 22 in imu_pwr_cycle.yaml) for 10 s when command/electrical asks for CYCLE_IMU.

children.name: talos/pinger_broker
children.role: Re-publishes the selected pinger frequency to ivc/pinger/set_freq_khz once a second.

children.name: talos/odom_to_world_broadcaster
children.role: Static identity transform world -> odom (the comment in the file: "until we get SLAM").

children.name: talos/depth_converter
children.role: Turns the pressure sensor's state/depth/raw into depth/pose for the EKF.

children.name: talos/ekf_localization_node
children.role: The EKF (robot_localization, talos_ekf.yaml, 30 Hz): fuses vectornav/imu, dvl_twist, gyro/twist and depth/pose into odometry/filtered and odom -> talos/base_link.

children.name: talos/robot_state_publisher
children.role: Builds Talos's URDF from riptide_descriptions2 robots/talos.xacro and publishes every fixed sensor and thruster frame on /tf_static.

children.name: talos/joint_state_publisher
children.role: Joint states for the URDF (read from /tmp/model.urdf, which navigation.launch.py writes).

children.name: talos/ffc/zed_state_publisher
children.role: The ZED X Mini's own frames (from zed_wrapper's URDF) under this camera's name.

children.name: talos/dfc/zed_state_publisher
children.role: The ZED X Mini's own frames (from zed_wrapper's URDF) under this camera's name.

children.name: talos/controller_overseer
children.role: Controller supervisor: publishes controller/motion_enabled and the feed-forward body force, warns when thruster telemetry stops.

children.name: talos/calibrate_drag
children.role: Drag calibration action server (used by the older controllers' tuning).

children.name: talos/complete_controller
children.role: The older controller, started when active_control_model is anything but mpc. Its package is not in the release workspace.

assumptions: zed_wrapper is read from the zed-ros2-wrapper sources in release/src (a laptop without the ZED SDK does not build it; the Orin does).
The Talos YAMLs are expanded as on the Orin: /home/ros/colcon_deploy exists, so control_system.launch.py takes its on-Orin branch.
The DVL's host name (uwrt-dvl) is not looked up; on the robot dvl.launch.py resolves it when the launch starts and exits if it can't.
